messages:
lisa_enterprise: Hi team — onboarding smoke tests failing. Using python-sdk v0.9.8. Getting 403 then lots of 429s after a manual key rotate. Running in a container with 5 concurrent worker threads.

marie_cs: thanks @lisa_enterprise. can you paste the error snippet and confirm whether this is a service account key or user key?

lisa_enterprise: snippet below. it's a service key we rotated from the console.
```
[2026-04-02T09:11:02Z] POST /v1/chat -> 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"generate:chat"}
[2026-04-02T09:11:05Z] key rotated by operator
[2026-04-02T09:11:05Z] worker-1 retrying request
[2026-04-02T09:11:05Z] worker-2 retrying request
[2026-04-02T09:11:05Z] worker-3 retrying request
[2026-04-02T09:11:06Z] 429 {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","limit":"sandbox_fanout"}
```

tom_devx: two separate issues here: the 403 indicates the new key doesn't have the generate:chat scope. the 429 burst is likely retries + parallel warmup hitting the fanout cap.

tom_devx: quick checklist: 1) confirm the role/scopes on the service key 2) temporarily reduce worker concurrency to 1 during rotation 3) use exponential backoff with jitter on retries 4) avoid aggressive token refresh during boot.

lisa_enterprise: confirmed — the new key was created from a template missing the chat role. fixing that now.

raj_infra: FYI our edge pool will reuse keepalives and can present a stale token if rotation happens without a drain window. we recommend a two-step rotate: issue new key, update clients, wait 45s, then revoke old. we can also set the key to 'draining' state server-side for a short window.

lisa_enterprise: noted. we do a rolling deploy across 5 containers which all warm up at once. i'll stagger warmup and drop concurrency.

infra-bot: quota-monitor: sandbox_fanout=80/min, current burst used=80 at 2026-04-02T09:11:06Z.

quota-monitor: @marie_cs can we grant a temporary +100 fanout for lisa_enterprise for 30 minutes to finish onboarding tests?

marie_cs: yes please. @raj_infra can you approve?

raj_infra: approved. temporary fanout +100 for 30m starting 2026-04-02T09:20:00Z. alerted monitoring to ignore transient alerts for that window.

tom_devx: also consider passing a token_provider callback to the python SDK so each request resolves the latest header instead of caching across socket pools. sample: 
```py
client = RedwoodClient(token_provider=lambda: get_current_token(), max_concurrency=2, retries=5)
```

lisa_enterprise: thanks everyone. i'll rerun after updating the key and staggering warmup. will post results in this thread.

marie_cs: ping us if the 403 persists after you update the key. good to have the fanout window while you validate. :sparkles:
